summary: This bill amends federal law to eliminate an affirmative defense for child pornography offenses and broaden the definition of "sexually explicit conduct" to include simulated obscene exhibitions, thereby prohibiting child pornography produced using artificial intelligence.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends federal law to eliminate an affirmative defense and expand the definition of 'sexually explicit conduct' in relation to child pornography, specifically addressing content produced using artificial intelligence. This directly strengthens laws against child pornography, aligning with stricter justice.
